title: Delhi High Court denies bail to Athar Khan in Delhi riots conspiracy case
description: The Delhi High Court on Tuesday denied bail to Athar Khan, one of the accused in the Delhi riots conspiracy case.A Division Bench of Justices Prathiba M Singh and Madhu Jain said that Khan's role in causing the death of people was prima facie established and that he is a flight risk. The Court added that he can influence the witnesses.A detailed order is awaited.
